name: Cir-Q-Tech Tako Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
india_angle: Cir-Q-Tech Tako Technologies Pvt Ltd has a manufacturing facility in Bidadi, Ramanagara, and offices in major Indian cities including Bangalore, Chennai, New Delhi, Hyderabad, and Pune.
summary: Cir-Q-Tech Tako Technologies Pvt Ltd specializes in providing Electro Static Discharge (ESD) control solutions, including products and services such as ESD flooring, workstations, and ionization equipment. They offer comprehensive ESD audits, training, and certification, catering to industries like automotive, aerospace, and telecom, with a significant presence in India.
